purpose: Self-description for the BMCU monitor's local HTTP API. Fetch this once, then every other endpoint can be decoded without reading the device source.
reading_notes: Endianness changes between layers. BMB1 and the local BSNP/BCAP formats are big-endian; everything inside a BMCU link frame is little-endian.

A STATUS field's absolute offset inside a BMB1 payload is bmcu_frame_prefix.size (10) + link_wire.header_size (7) + the status_payload offset. Reading a slot mask at offset 13 instead of 30 is the mistake this note exists to prevent.

channel_flags at status_payload offset 27 and bits 8-12 of the channel record's u16 flags are the same byte; ks there narrows what online_mask only says as one bit, and the three latches are the three different reasons a channel LED turns red.
inserted_mask is channel hardware presence, not filament. online_mask is filament. The web UI mislabelled this for a long time.

Compare the BMCU-reported crc_error and rx_drop in status_payload against the Pico decoder counters in diagnostic_tags: matching rates mean a shared cause, one-sided means the loss is in that direction only.
A counter that does not advance is as informative as one that does. Sample twice and report the delta with the elapsed time, not the absolute value.

bmb1_envelope.description: BMB1 message header, pico/bmcu_binary.py write_header, format >4sBBHIQQB3s

fields.name: link_index
fields.note: 255 is bridge scope

bmcu_frame_prefix.description: BMCU_FRAME payload prefix before the verbatim link wire frame, write_bmcu_frame format >QH

capture_record.description: /api/capture.bin record: UART bytes the decoder rejected. Local diagnostic format.

fields.name: ordinal
fields.note: capture count for that link, gaps mean older runs were overwritten

fields.name: payload_length
fields.note: max 8

fields.name: payload
fields.note: union, interpreted by record_type

fields.name: record_flags
fields.note: reserved; the BMCU emits zero

fields.name: record_data
fields.note: for record_type 2 (channel) the u16 at record_data offset 6 carries bits 0-4 of per-record flags and bits 8-12 as the status_payload channel_flags byte shifted left by 8, same bit order

link_record.description: Synthetic snapshot record 240: link state that no FULL_STATUS record carries

fields.name: snapshot_age_ms
fields.note: age of every other record in this snapshot. 65535 means at least that old, never taken, or no clock yet -- in all three cases do not read the snapshot as current. Force a refresh with GET /api/snapshot.bin?refresh=1, which lands on the following request.

fields.name: tick_hz
fields.note: 0 when the BMCU has not sent HELLO; the PROBE record (full_status_record_type 13) carries it unconditionally

link_wire.description: BMCU Link frame, pico/bmcu_link.py encode_frame. Note the endianness change: sequence and CRC are little-endian while every BMB1 field above is big-endian.

fields.name: payload_length
fields.note: max 57

fields.name: crc16_ccitt_false
fields.note: over bytes 2..len-2

log_payload.description: PICO_LOG payload, pico/bmcu_binary.py write_log, format >QQBBHH then three byte runs

printer_transaction_payload.description: event_payload payload when record_type is 3 (printer_transaction). Emitted only for rejected or failed transactions, with a 5 s per-key repeat suppression window.

fields.name: command
fields.note: raw wire byte, buf[4] for short frames and buf[11] for long ones. Does NOT identify the frame -- use rx_class

fields.name: request_length
fields.note: saturating at 255

fields.name: response_length
fields.note: 0 with outcome failed and reason no_response means the frame was ours, a reply was expected, and none was produced

fields.name: addressed_ams
fields.note: the AMS number the frame targets, 255 when the frame carries no AMS address. Frames for another AMS on the bus no longer emit this record at all; their volume is in the probe record's foreign_count

fields.name: rx_class
fields.note: the bambubus_package_type the parser resolved: 1 filament_motion_short, 2 filament_motion_long, 3 online_detect, 4 REQx6, 5 NFC_detect, 6 set_filament_info, 7 MC_online, 8 read_filament_info, 9 set_filament_info_type2, 10 version, 11 serial_number, 12 heartbeat, 13 ETC. 0 means the frame resolved to nothing, which includes long frames addressed to another AMS

probe_record_data.description: record_data of full_status_record when record_type is 13 (probe). Makes a snapshot self-describing: tick_hz is otherwise only in HELLO, which is sent once at BMCU init, so a bridge that attached or resynced later cannot convert any hw_tick32 to seconds.

fields.name: tick_hz
fields.note: hardware tick rate; hw_tick32 wraps every 2^32/tick_hz seconds, about 239 s at 18 MHz

fields.name: foreign_count
fields.note: frames addressed to another AMS on the bus, suppressed from the event stream; this is the only place their volume appears

fields.name: unsupported_type
fields.note: long-frame types the parser resolved to nothing, first-seen-wins; 0 means the slot is unused

fields.name: unsupported_count
fields.note: occurrences of the type at the same index, saturating at 65535

snapshot_record.description: /api/snapshot.bin record. Local diagnostic format, never sent to Bambuddy.

fields.name: record_type
fields.note: 240 is a synthetic link record, 241 a retained EVENT

fields.name: payload
fields.note: verbatim record_data for real record types, event_payload for 241, link_record for 240

status_payload.description: kind 2 STATUS, BMCUMonitor._decode_status. Absolute offset inside a BMB1 BMCU_FRAME payload is bmcu_frame_prefix.size + link_wire.header_size + offset.

fields.name: tx_drop
fields.note: BMCU transmit queue drops

fields.name: rx_drop
fields.note: BMCU receive drops

fields.name: crc_error
fields.note: BMCU side, compare with the Pico decoder counters to tell direction

fields.name: current_slot
fields.note: 255 means none selected

fields.name: inserted_mask
fields.note: per-channel HARDWARE presence, latched at boot from the PULL potentiometer. Not filament.

fields.name: online_mask
fields.note: per-channel filament detection: the microswitch, gated by inserted_mask

fields.name: pull_pct
fields.note: 50 is neutral

bitfields.name: ks
bitfields.note: switch reading, 0=none 1=both 2=external only 3=internal only. Single-microswitch builds only ever send 0 or 1.

bitfields.name: low
bitfields.note: g_on_use_low_latch: pull fell below 40% during pressure_ctrl_on_use, motor stopped

bitfields.name: jam
bitfields.note: g_on_use_jam_latch: the jam variant of low, also raises HMS 0xF06F. Set only together with low.

bitfields.name: dm_fail
bitfields.note: dm_fail_latch: DM autoload stage 1 or 2 failed. Clears only on ks==0, a full withdrawal.

bitfields.name: loaded
bitfields.note: this channel owns the shared PTFE merger: g_loaded_ch, the flash-backed mutex on the one output tube all four channels feed. Set in both LOADED and TAIL, because both are ownership. Re-acquired only by a printer-commanded load, so releasing it wrongly desynchronises it from the printer; an unload addressed to that channel then does nothing and leaves no trace. Only a printer command releases it -- a key reading empty demotes to TAIL instead, after LOADED_LATCH_DROP_MS. At most one channel sets it.

bitfields.name: tail
bitfields.note: this channel still owns the merger but its filament has passed the online key, so the switch can no longer see it. The runout state: the tail clears the switch before the printer commands the retract, and the retract must still be accepted. Only ever set together with loaded. Was reserved before firmware revision 8; a decoder that ignores it still reads loaded correctly.

bitfields.name: reserved
bitfields.note: sent as zero, ignore on receive

fields.name: channel_flags
fields.note: per-channel fault latches and raw switch state. Decode with explicit shifts; the firmware union in src/bmcu_link.h is MCU-internal and its bitfield order is compiler-defined.

tlv.description: Diagnostic and log-detail triplet, pico/bmcu_binary.py write_tlv

thresholds.note: the durable ring size; a depth pinned here is steady state, not a stall, if LAST_ACK_WATERMARK is advancing
the 5 s log suppression hides the rate: the counter advances on every exception while only one line per window is logged
per link; healthy is zero since the DMA receive path landed
